desc: This API — deterministic tasks over 15 real connectome wirings (maps of living nervous systems captured by electron microscopy). Every answer comes with a receipt you can replay yourself and get the identical result.

plain: Every result leaves a permanent fingerprint
desc: As receipts: every reading and task is content-addressed and persisted — tamper-evident commitments, not bulk storage. What runs today is the evidence ledger; organism-bound store is consent-gated below.

Passive multimodal sensing — audio, ultrasonic, environmental, camera, hydrophone front-end on one ~$35–45 node. Nothing attaches, nothing enters soil. Firmware + actors e2e-tested; field-validation gate E0 not yet run.
The second evidence lane — multi-node fleet readings folding into quorum. Same gate: admitted only when the lane's evidence SAID lands.
Node→node mesh hops — Reticulum store-and-forward carrying only content-addressed bundles: an intent names the packet SAID it moves or it refuses. The network hop, not the biological one.

plain: Talking back — only with two keys
desc: The write lane exists and is fully implemented — it rides only on joint guardian + operator consent, duty-cycled minimum power, every burst logged and receipted.
Broadcast lane — same joint-consent gate: guardian + operator, consent credential SAID, never a default.
Organism-bound storage — writing into living systems. Consent-gated by policy; distinct from the evidence ledger running above.

plain: Asking a plant to carry a message
desc: Relay through living wiring — refused outright: consent is not evidence. E5 is the graduation path: its preserved-wiring harness already passes (15/15 relays replay bit-for-bit across two verifiers), the living half stays refused until evidence lands.

plain: Asking a forest to do math
desc: Living-systems compute — refused until an evidence SAID lands. What the field has published as possible is cited on /science — we claim the receipts, not the miracle.
Engineered-biology lanes — refused outright. Natural and wild systems only; no engineered substrate carries a lane here.
